newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: INDEPENDENT IN S.AFRICA J-V WITH CONDE NAST.
newsitem.headline: INDEPENDENT IN S.AFRICA J-V WITH CONDE NAST.

text.p: Ireland's Independent Newspapers and Conde Nast International said on Friday they had formed a joint venture to publish magazines in South Africa.

The agreement was signed in Dublin on Thursday and the publishing of magazine House and Garden in South Africa in 1998 would be Conde Nast's first publishing venture in Africa, the companies said in a statement released in Johannesburg.

"Conde Nast are the best magazine publishers in the world, with a wonderful stable of titles, and will bring a new dimension to the magazine market in South Africa," Tony O'Reilly, chairman of Independent Newspapers said.
Conde Nast publishes more than 50 magazines in the world including Vogue, Glamour and Vanity Fair.

Independent's unit in South Africa Independent Newspapers Holdings Ltd publishes 4.5 million newspapers every week, accounting for 50 percent of the total South African market and 67 percent of the EngLish speaking market.
